text_block_list.text:
"This Arima Kinen was supposed to be...
the final showdown of the year between
Neo Universe and Zenno Rob Roy."
It was supposed to be a festival where they competed to see who'd win. But the result was...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you guys! Line up over there.
No excuses, come on, hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
After all the hype, neither of them won?
What a pathetic showing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy, do you have any excuses?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe has a 'cause of defeat.'
...A clear one."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: In other words, Neo Universe today—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? How is that clear at all!?
I don't get it at all!
Stop dodging the question with random ancient runes!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, fine. Now I get it.
Either way, if I'm not in the race, it's no good.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry, I'll run with you next year!
Let's see, maybe around the Takarazuka Kinen☆

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You two had better show up, okay?
Until then, practice...!
Due to my pathetic results, the little witch totally held it over me.
